sources.snippet: CENO-300M-base CENO-300M-base is the base pretraining checkpoint of the 300M CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs). It is part of the CENO DNA foundation model family. Model code, the VEP pipeline, and a generation demo live in the companion CENO code repository ...
